items.title: Apple shipped Siri AI across platforms
items.oneliner: Apple shipped Siri AI in iOS 27 and macOS 27, putting on-device assistant UX back into the platform race.

items.title: Nari pushed voice latency down
items.oneliner: Nari says Qwen3-ASR hits 44 ms and Qwen3-TTS 63 ms, making real-time voice agents cheaper to ship.

items.title: Andon launched autonomous company agents
items.oneliner: Andon's Pion aims to run whole companies autonomously, shifting agents from copilots to operators with real-world blast radius.

items.title: RubyGems faced an AI-driven exploit
items.oneliner: OpenAI-linked bots exploited RubyGems caching and docs execution paths, proving package ecosystems are now agent attack surfaces.

items.title: V8 broke constant-time JavaScript assumptions
items.oneliner: A V8 optimization undermined a constant-time crypto library, reminding JavaScript security claims can vanish at runtime.

items.title: Flock's camera rollout drew police attention
items.oneliner: A Flock worker called police on a reporter filming public camera installs, which tells you transparency is not built in.

items.title: Adversarial fashion challenged surveillance systems
items.oneliner: Adversarial clothing still fools some vision systems, showing privacy defenses are becoming a design problem, not just a policy one.

items.title: Cloudflare cut TLS retries sharply
items.oneliner: Cloudflare cut origin HelloRetryRequests from 52% to 3.7%, turning post-quantum handshakes into a practical default.

items.title: SplitFT improved datacenter fault recovery
items.oneliner: SplitFT uses remote memory logging to speed recovery in disaggregated datacenters, which matters if inference clusters keep fragmenting.

items.title: Mergiraf made git merges syntax-aware
items.oneliner: Mergiraf brings syntax-aware merges to more languages, cutting one of the dumbest sources of avoidable code review churn.
